name: Squared Away - 2.0 Update
body:
A rebuilt inventory with saved layouts, persistent rigs and boxes, direct gear transfers, and the new Field Kit interface.

- **Update ZIP:** install through MO2; choose only the patches you use.
- **Engine ZIP:** required. Includes DX8/9/10/11, AVX and non-AVX, plus matching DB0. Extract into your Anomaly folder.
- **For Developers ZIP:** engine source changes and merge diff; players can skip it.

**Start a new game when upgrading from the previous public version.** Use Mags Reloaded Fork by Priler UPDATE 6 for the baseline magazine/pouch content.

[Guide, patch notes and ZoneBench](https://fomok.github.io/zonebench/)

name: 2026.9.12 + Squared Away
body:
Custom moddedexes based on 2026.9.12 from themrdemonized to work with Squared Away new version (3.48+)

attached all DX version but only tested on DX11-AVX but should work on other.

also zip with files for engine merge for developers that know what to do with it.
